title: This guy isn't just for show (Lossless C++, Zodiac Deck)
description:
https://ko-fi.com/drspectred

Zodiac Deck: 

FNSD85BC

In Balatro, when you complete a Gold Stake run (the highest level of difficulty), your Jokers earn Gold Stickers. In this video series, we earned all 150 Gold Stickers without losing a single run, playing only the Zodiac Deck. I put the seeds in the video descriptions so you can try the runs yourself. In the interest of learning, I encourage you to play the seed(s) first before watching what I might do differently.

Mod list/info: https://bit.ly/4qXxtdN

Commission her here: https://bsky.app/profile/dottykitty.bsky.social
https://www.instagram.com/dottykittyy/

You can get the BalatroU "art pack" (and text changes) here: 
https://github.com/OceanRamen/BUMod/releases 
Originally coded by Djynasty, now maintained by SleepyG11 (creator of the Handy Mod). 
More than half of the artwork by Omega:
https://www.instagram.com/omegaflowey18 

For more information, consider joining the "supporters only" Balatro University Discord either by any one-time Twitch subscription or minimum Ko-Fi contribution. After signing up, go to your Discord Settings and look for "Connections."
